{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Thermal base layer, slim fit, hip length, soft heather grey (#B8B8BC), merino wool

Fine-knit turtleneck sweater, regular fit, hip length, deep navy (#1F2A44), merino wool blend

Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full ankle length, charcoal (#3A3D42), lined wool flannel

Thermal tights, opaque, worn under the trousers, black (#1A1A1A), brushed wool-blend knit

Long coat, straight cut, below the knee, with a hood-free high collar, camel (#B08A5E), dense wool with a water-repellent finish

Ankle boots, flat block heel, round toe, lined, black (#1C1C1C), waterproof leather with a grippy rubber sole

Beanie, close fit, ribbed, burgundy (#6B2B3A), merino wool

Scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice, soft grey-blue (#8C9BAA), brushed wool

Gloves, lined, black (#1A1A1A), leather with a cashmere lining

Tote bag, structured, medium size, zip top, dark brown (#3E2C26), grained leather

This outfit suits a 20-minute walk to the office in deep frost and snow, with a thermal base, a merino turtleneck and lined wool trousers keeping the warmth close to the body. The neat business look holds up under the coat, since the sweater and trousers are a classic, polished pairing. The waterproof boots with a rubber sole give grip on snowy, salted pavements and stay clean for the office. The navy, charcoal and camel palette is calm and professional, and the grey-blue scarf echoes the cool tone of your eyes while the burgundy beanie adds a warm accent near your face."}
